name: arc-gallery-hero
title: Arc Gallery Hero
description: Full-screen hero: square photo cards fanned along a half-circle arc across the top (each tilted with the curve, fading up one after another), with a centred big headline, description and two pill buttons underneath.
darkMode: shadcn tokens (background, foreground, muted, border, primary, accent) - follows the theme
mainProps: images: string[], title, description (ReactNode), primaryAction / secondaryAction ({label, href} or null), startAngle/endAngle, radiusLg/Md/Sm, cardSizeLg/Md/Sm, className
notes: min-h-screen. 10-14 images look best. Rewritten from the 21st.dev original: copy and buttons were hard-coded (now props, buttons are links), gray/indigo replaced with theme tokens, sizes moved from a JS resize listener to CSS (no layout jump after hydration on mobile), scoped keyframes, reduced motion, no remote fallback image.
